title: The Next 25
lede: Twenty-five Seed to Series A startups to watch. Mostly US, picked for fresh money, strong backers and real traction.
method: Every company here is already on the Well Run board. We keep the ones whose headquarters and most of the team are in the US, that are still private and independent, and whose latest round is Seed or Series A (extensions included). Then we rank by promise: how recent and how strong the last round was, who led it, real traction (revenue, customers, usage) and hiring momentum. Each pick gets a fresh check for layoffs, lawsuits and down rounds; anything unresolved stays off. Hand-picked, updated as rounds land. Each line links to its source.

picks.name: Prime Intellect
picks.why: Open training stack for AI agents; past $100M in annualized revenue in under a year with 6,000+ customers.

picks.name: OpenArt
picks.why: AI studio for images and video; ARR went from $70M at its January raise to close to $200M by October, profitable, team about 4x.

picks.name: Pocket
picks.why: A $129 AI notetaker that clips to your phone; went from $1M to a $100M run rate in about seven months with a team of roughly a dozen.

picks.name: Halluminate
picks.why: Nine people, zero to a mid-eight-figure run rate in ten months and profitable; four of the five top US AI labs pay for its finance training environments.

picks.name: XDOF
picks.why: Robot training data out of stealth in June; revenue run-rate near $50M and already in talks for a B at $1.2B.

picks.name: 7AI
picks.why: Largest Series A in cybersecurity history; its SOC agents passed 7M investigations and it is adding 100 jobs in Boston.

picks.name: Latent
picks.why: Prior-authorization AI for health-system pharmacies; grew from 4 to 45+ health systems in a year with $20M+ in annualized revenue.

picks.name: Resolve AI
picks.why: AI for production incidents at Coinbase and DoorDash; $1.5B valuation and bookings up 128% quarter over quarter.

picks.name: Tessera Labs
picks.why: Automates SAP and ERP overhauls; multimillion-dollar Fortune 500 contracts and a team that nearly tripled since May.

picks.name: Poetic
picks.why: Turns bank and insurer procedures into reliable automations; hit an eight-figure run rate and profitability in 2025 with four people.

picks.name: OpenFX
picks.why: Miami-based FX rails for fintechs; annualized volume went from $4B to $45B+ in a year and revenue grew 10x.

picks.name: Qualitate
picks.why: AI-run expert interviews for investors and corporates; run rate up 10x+ in 2026 with net revenue retention over 300%.

picks.name: Canals
picks.why: AI order entry for wholesale distributors; profitable before raising, 100+ distributors, headcount about 3x in a year.

picks.name: Roadrunner
picks.why: AI-native quoting for enterprise sales; ARR up 3x and customers 6x in the first quarter after its A, with Asana and ZoomInfo on board.

picks.name: Lassie
picks.why: AI that runs billing for dental practices; 700+ practices in 49 states and past $10M in annualized revenue, mostly by referral.

picks.name: Kastle
picks.why: AI agents for loan servicing and collections; live at 10 of the top 25 US mortgage servicers with $2B+ in transactions processed.

picks.name: Picogrid
picks.why: Software that connects military systems; revenue tripled year over year and it is cash-flow positive.

picks.name: Lightfield
picks.why: AI-native CRM from the Tome founders; 5,000+ companies signed up in its first ten months, some moving whole Salesforce setups over.

picks.name: Probook
picks.why: AI dispatch for HVAC and plumbing shops; one 14-location customer booked 2,500+ jobs in its first month with no human touch.

picks.name: Collate
picks.why: AI for life-sciences regulatory paperwork; about 50 pharma, biotech and medtech customers in a year and a valuation near $1B.

picks.name: Baselayer
picks.why: Business identity and fraud checks used by 2,300+ financial institutions, about 1 in 5 US banks; now verifying AI agents too.

picks.name: AegisAI
picks.why: Ex-Google security leads stopping AI spear phishing; went from 3 paying customers to dozens in ten months.

picks.name: Flai
picks.why: AI that answers car-dealership calls and books service; revenue up 20x in a year and 50,000 appointments a month.

picks.name: Vitalize
picks.why: Hospital staffing and scheduling AI; St. Luke's cut premium labor spend 54% in 12 weeks and is rolling it out system-wide.

picks.name: TerraFirma
picks.why: Ex-SpaceX team running remote, semi-autonomous earthmoving crews on paid Texas jobs; plans 300 hires in a year.
